RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

It depends on whether you plan to pursue a formal discrimination claim or preserve professional relationships. An all-male panel in engineering often reflects industry demographics rather than deliberate bias, but unconscious affinity bias is plausible given your greater experience versus the subjective rationale ("client relationships"). 

If seeking constructive feedback or future opportunities, do not raise it; it will trigger defensiveness. Instead, follow up cordially on your feedback request, asking for objective scoring criteria.

However, if you intend to challenge the decision legally, document everything and consult an employment lawyer—an all-male panel and significant qualification gap can serve as supporting context.
